summary: 2 film announcements, 5 TV announcements across 5 trades.

film.title: The Dink
film.announcement: Andy Roddick lands his first major acting role in the film, with co-star Jake Johnson praising his comedic performance.

film.title: The Exiles
film.talent: Sam Worthington, David Duchovny, Ke-Xi Wu
film.announcement: Director Midi Z's film draws on Joseph Conrad's 'Heart of Darkness' and features the cast in an adaptation of the classic novel.

tv.title: Star Trek: Starfleet Academy
tv.announcement: Ruaridh Aldington added as series regular for Season 2, announced at Comic-Con.

tv.title: Star Trek Scouts
tv.announcement: Second season premiere set for Star Trek Day on YouTube, announced at Comic-Con.

tv.title: Futurama
tv.announcement: Hulu greenlights three extended special episodes ahead of Season 14, including a Christmas episode, with new trailer debuting at Comic-Con.

tv.title: Bob's Burgers
tv.announcement: New holiday short titled 'On the Fort Day of Christmas' set to premiere on Hulu.

tv.title: Little House on the Prairie
tv.announcement: Luke Bracey embraces his character Pa's flaws in the series, discussing the creative approach to the role in Season 1.
